sentence: A0 (Q-F0): PASS; n = 80 domain sessions of 94 launched (map 0: 40/41, map 1: 39/39 on the clean-role label); P = 79/80 = 0.9875; Δ_c = +0.4875, two-sided Clopper–Pearson 95% CI [+0.4323, +0.4997]; E = 0.0625 from A0s (18/32 domain sessions, P_sham = 0.5625); P_arm − P_sham = +0.4250; exact one-sided binomial vs 0.5: p = 0.0000 toward clean, p = 1.0000 toward corrupted, α = .01; pre-pick exclusion rate 14/94 = 0.1489 beside A0s's 3/35 = 0.0857; the guard at the unit's last look (the end look at 129 launches): Fisher one-sided vs A0s p = 0.2648, not fired (binding); absolute vs .20 p = 0.9183, not fired (binding).

dead_tail.test: P(X <= k), X ~ Bin(n, 13/20): DEAD iff < 1/40 and k < n (the two-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound on Delta_c < +0.15)

guard_abs.test: exact one-sided binomial of the arm's pre-pick exclusions vs .20, alpha .05, at the unit's last look (m:316)

guard_fisher.test: one-sided Fisher exact, the arm's pre-pick exclusions vs its sham's, alpha .05, at the unit's last look (m:316)

p_down.test: exact one-sided binomial vs 0.5 toward corrupted, P(X <= k), X ~ Bin(n, 1/2); (iii) for REVERSE at alpha .01

p_up.test: exact one-sided binomial vs 0.5 toward clean, P(X >= k), X ~ Bin(n, 1/2); (iii) at alpha .01
